title: Sequential physical inventory correction persistence orchestration
discoveryDecision: Use explicit non-atomic sequential fail-fast orchestration. The canonical single-movement writer performs its own exact movement read, exact batch read, insert and race-recovery read. No canonical transaction context exists that can wrap those calls while reusing the writer unchanged.
input: One canonical FOOD-006T physical inventory correction movement candidate result.
preStorageValidation: FOOD-006T input is revalidated before any database access.
No-correction provenance is rederived through canonical FOOD-006T.
Candidate allocation provenance is rederived through canonical FOOD-006T.
Every supplied candidate movement is canonically revalidated.
Candidate ordering, exact SKU, allocation plan and movement content must match canonical FOOD-006T output.
Tampered input returns invalid before persistence.
noCorrection: Performs zero physical movement database calls.
execution: Candidates are processed in canonical FOOD-006T order.
appendFoodPhysicalInventoryMovement is the only movement persistence writer used.
The writer is invoked exactly once for each attempted candidate.
conflict, invalid and storage-failure are blocking.
Processing stops immediately at the first blocking result.
No later candidate is attempted after a blocking result.
completed: Every per-candidate result was created or already-present.
Every exact per-candidate writer result is preserved.
blocked: Every attempted result up to and including the blocker is preserved.
The blocking attempt and index are preserved.
Exact identities of remaining unattempted candidates are exposed.
Earlier durable success is never hidden.
No rollback is claimed or attempted.
The bundle is not described as atomic.
retry: Re-running the same canonical FOOD-006T bundle revisits prior durable movement IDs through the canonical single-movement writer, which preserves created/already-present/conflict/storage-failure semantics.
postWrite: FOOD-006U stops at movement append outcomes. It does not acquire a new evidence head, rebuild authoritative recorded balance, rerun FOOD-006P, or perform another physical reconciliation.
doesNotEstablish: rollback of earlier durable movement writes
physical truth of the underlying count
physical truth of caller batch allocation
